overview.description: The Roundhill Magnificent Seven Covered Call ETF (MAGY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund uses a fund-of-funds approach to provide current income and capped gains on MAGS ETF through a covered call strategy. The fund provides long exposure to Magnificent Seven tech companies, while using both standardized exchange-traded and FLEX options. MAGY was launched on Apr 23, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
